settings.repere: Intertitre · What is Spot & Tango?
settings.text: What is Spot & Tango?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Spot & Tango delivers ready-to-serve, …
settings.text: Spot & Tango delivers ready-to-serve, high-quality meals that fit your dog’s unique nutritional needs. In each shipment, you’ll receive the best health and wellness products for your dog(s), including our Fresh or UnKibble meals, and the option to add-on Snacks and Supplements.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Take our quiz now to find your dog’s p…
settings.text: Take our quiz now to find your dog’s personalized plan!

settings.repere: Intertitre · What are the recipes and ingredients?
settings.text: What are the recipes and ingredients?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Spot & Tango offers a variety of recip…
settings.text: Spot & Tango offers a variety of recipes to support different dietary needs. Each one is formulated by our veterinary nutritionists to be 100% complete and balanced according to AAFCO standards, using only human-grade ingredients.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Our recipes starts with USDA meat as t…
settings.text: Our recipes starts with USDA meat as the #1 ingredient, paired with simple whole fruits, veggies, and grains, then carefully balanced with high-quality supplemental vitamins and minerals. We source restaurant-quality ingredients from trusted human food suppliers—never feed-grade—and prepare our meals in small batches using slow, gentle cooking methods to preserve the natural nutrition in every ingredient.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · You can find the full ingredient list …
settings.text: You can find the full ingredient list for your dog’s recommended recipes in our short quiz.

settings.repere: Intertitre · How much does Spot & Tango cost?
settings.text: How much does Spot & Tango cost?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Every dog is unique, so pricing depend…
settings.text: Every dog is unique, so pricing depends on factors like age, weight, activity level, and recipe selection. UnKibble plans start at about $1/day, with delivery options ranging from 1 week to 2 months of food. All plans include free shipping.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · To see your dog’s exact pricing, just …
settings.text: To see your dog’s exact pricing, just fill out our short quiz.

settings.repere: Intertitre · How does Spot & Tango determine portio…
settings.text: How does Spot & Tango determine portion sizes?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · We work closely with our veterinary nu…
settings.text: We work closely with our veterinary nutritionists to determine the ideal calorie needs for each dog based on age, weight, activity level, and more. Of course, every dog is different, so some may need adjustments over time, especially growing puppies!

settings.repere: Paragraphe · To see your dog’s recommended meal pla…
settings.text: To see your dog’s recommended meal plan, just fill out our short quiz.

settings.repere: Intertitre · Do I need to refrigerate the food?
settings.text: Do I need to refrigerate the food?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Nope! UnKibble is fresh without the fr…
settings.text: Nope! UnKibble is fresh without the fridge—just as delicious and nutritious for your pup, without the hassle. It won’t take up valuable fridge space or require any of the prep and mess that frozen food does. Simply store it in the pantry, scoop, and serve. It’s ideal for travel, busy schedules, or anyone looking for the highest-quality dog food without the extra work.

settings.repere: Intertitre · How do shipments work?
settings.text: How do shipments work?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Spot & Tango meal plans are delivered …
settings.text: Spot & Tango meal plans are delivered on a recurring schedule, perfectly timed so your dog never runs out of food. Plans are customized to fit your dog’s needs and include a convenient scoop for each recipe, pre-measuring their exact portions to make feeding easy.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Your pup’s food arrives in a box, deli…
settings.text: Your pup’s food arrives in a box, delivered right to your door exactly when you need it. You’ll always have the flexibility to adjust deliveries online— reschedule shipments, or pause anytime!
